title: Demo sales by region

steps.thinking: The demo files hold the same sales as CSV and Excel. Sum the amounts per region from the Excel file, check the grand total against the CSV, and draw a bar chart.
steps.text: I'll total the sales per region from the Excel file, check the result against the CSV, and draw a chart.

The demo data holds **2,000 sales** worth **2,245,224** in all, and the Excel and CSV files agree.

| Region | Total |
|---|---:|
| West | 603,957 |
| South | 582,012 |
| North | 545,951 |
| East | 513,304 |

West sells the most and East the least: West is about 18% ahead.
